items.w: יהוה דבר ויקרא ארץ ממזרח שמש עד מבאו
items.title: THE UNIVERSAL G-D
items.quote: Hashem has spoken, summoning the inhabited world, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
items.text: All of mankind without exception is subject to the rule of G-d.

items.title: THE PRESENCE OF G-D
items.quote: Out of Tzion, epitome of beauty, G-d appeared.
items.text: Although Hashem pervades the entire universe, His most intense Presence is associated with Yerushalayim.

items.w: אש לפניו תאכל וסביביו נשערה מאד
items.title: FIRE AND WIND
items.quote: a consuming fire before Him, surrounded with an intense storm-wind.
items.text: The unlimited power of Hashem may be symbolized in human terms by the images of fire and wind.

items.w: יקרא אל השמים מעל ואל הארץ לדין עמו
items.title: HEAVEN AND EARTH
items.quote: He summons the heavens above and the earth so that He may judge His people.
items.text: Hashem summons heaven and earth to bear witness when Yisrael is being judged.

items.w: ויגידו שמים צדקו כי אלהים שפט הוא סלה
items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUDGMENT
items.quote: The heavens proclaim His righteousness, for G-d is the Judge.
items.text: The heavens which outlast human history can see that the judgment of Hashem is true and fair. Thus, they are called upon to proclaim His righteousness.

items.w: לא על זבחיך אוכיחך ועולתיך לנגדי תמיד
items.title: EMPTY RITES
items.quote: I will not be rebuking you for your sacrifices, for your burnt-offerings [have been] continually before me.
items.text: Hashem is not concerned with empty rites, even when they fulfill the requirements. He wants your sincere confession of sin and teshuvah.

items.w: זבח לאלהים תודה ושלם לעליון נדריך
items.quote: Offer to God confession. Then, fulfill your vows to the Most High.

items.w: מה לך לספר חקי ותשא בריתי עלי פיך
items.title: EMPTY LEARNING
items.quote: Why do you recite My laws? And carry My covenant in your mouth?
items.text: Hashem wants the learning of Torah to be internalized and honored with action.

items.w: ואתה שנאת מוסר ותשלך דברי אחריך
items.quote: You have detested mussar. You threw My words behind you.

items.w: זבח תודה יכבדנני ושם דרך אראנו בישע אלהים
items.quote: [The one who] brings a sacrificial offering of confession, honors Me. If he sets [an upright] way, I will show him the yeshuah of G-d.
